newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia to split up General Communications.
newsitem.headline: Nokia to split up General Communications.

text.p: Nokia Oy said in its January-September interim report on Thursday it would split its General Communications Products unit into two in order to increase efficiency.

"To further increase operational efficiency, Nokia General Communications Products business group will be reorganised in January into two divisions: Multimedia Network Terminals and Industrial Electronics," it said.
It now defined its core businesses as "telecom operator driven infrastructure business, end-user driven terminal business, integrated solutions business and other telcom related businesses".
